verdict.rationale: Azure's first-party pricing pages show that a free account exists and that free services are published ('Create Your Azure Free Account', 'Explore Free Azure Services'), so a founder can start at no cost. The evidence is only page titles, though: none of it states the free-tier limits, credit amounts, expiry windows, or any startup credit program. Missing for 10: spelled-out free-tier limits and quotas, credit amount and expiry terms, a published startup credits program, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
